backend/tests running under pytest-xdist have a race condition: parallel workers create/delete invoices in the same accounting year, so summary/income-statement tests that snapshot totals can flake. Not a product bug — but the test suite should either use `pytest.mark.serial` for those cases, or `pytest.ini` should switch to `--dist loadfile`. Currently `loadscope` distributes test classes across workers, so tests inside different classes race. Recommend adding a `pytestmark = pytest.mark.serial` OR moving all invoice-mutation tests into a single class so loadscope keeps them together.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in iteration 50 scope. The xdist race is a TEST INFRASTRUCTURE concern only, not a product bug. Reproduce: `pytest backend/tests/test_iteration50_full.py -v` (uses pytest.ini's -n --dist loadscope) → summary/income-statement tests may snapshot mid-way through another worker's create/delete. Mitigation: run with `-o addopts=` to disable xdist, or add `pytestmark = pytest.mark.serial` on the mutation classes.
